result.title: How Should a Camera-First AI Agent Work?
result.comment: 8 pages, 4 figures, 3 tables. Position/contract paper on time-critical camera-first agents (systems/timing).Primary cs.AI;
result.summary: Camera-first agents must act on the visual world as it unfolds. We argue that the central obstacle for future camera-first agents is not recognition ability - multimodal models (vision-language and live/streaming alike) generalize well through language and remain the right tool for semantic reasoning - but time. Many visual targets are ephemeral: they appear, are query-relevant, and leave within a short window. Binding memory to the same end-to-end path as reasoning means that by the time a monolithic pipeline completes, the evidence is gone. We formalize this as Ephemeral-Target Interaction (ETI) and a Perceptual Deadline Contract separating a hard memory deadline from a soft reasoning deadline, grounded in the bounded, passive nature of sensory and working memory. We propose a two-deadline architecture: an always-on, bounded, non-semantic fast path; an active remembering mechanism that commits a moment to durable memory before it is overwritten (event-driven in v1); and a deferred deliberation layer (multimodal model + tools). We instantiate the contract on real MOT17 track windows, a consistency check, and calibrate the single-path baseline from measured frontier-model latency: even a short answer takes 1.2-9.3 s, and an agentic identify-and-search longer. Answers can be late; evidence cannot be missed.

AI.brief_summary: 一篇立场/契约论文，把时敏「相机优先」智能体的核心障碍归结为时间而非识别能力，形式化「短暂目标交互」并提出分离硬记忆截止与软推理截止的双截止架构（常开非语义快路径、主动记忆机制、延迟推理层），在 MOT17 轨迹窗口上做一致性检验，并以前沿模型实测延迟校准单路径基线。
AI.relevance_reason: 与 LVR 的 LOOK/STOP 和证据获取直接相关：硬记忆截止对应「错过即不可恢复」的视觉证据保留问题，软推理截止与 1.2–9.3 s 延迟测量可供核查 THINK/LOOK 的时序预算、证据筛选与停止决策成本。
